title: pbmc, non POD group, at Post 24h
extract_protocol_ch1: Peripheral blood mononuclear cells were isolated by density gradient centrifugation using Ficoll Hypaque density solution. Cells were used only if >80% were viable based on trypan blue staining, in which case they were subjected to single-cell RNA sequencing.

An appropriate volume of peripheral blood mononuclear cells was loaded onto a 10X Genomics Chromium instrument to capture 8000 single cells according to the manufacturer’s instructions for the 10X Genomics Chromium Single-Cell 5’ kit (version 2). Subsequent cDNA amplification and library construction were performed according to the standard protocol. Libraries were sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000 sequencing system (paired-end multiplexing run, 150 bp) at LC-Bio Technology (Hangzhou, China) at a minimum depth of 20,000 reads per cell.
data_processing: CellRanger software (version 7.0.0, 10X Genomics) was used to analyze the sequencing data, and gene expression information for each cell was obtained.
Assembly: Ensembol V105
Supplementary files format and content: Tab-separated values and Matrix files
